models.name: InSight lander — arm and solar panels deployed, before instrument deployment
models.creator: NASA/Brian E. Kumanchik
models.usage: NASA educational/informational media usage guidelines; credit creator/source, preserve any third-party notices, do not imply NASA endorsement.
models.modifications: None. Downloaded bytes, geometry, transforms, proportions, materials and embedded textures retained.
models.verification: Official NASA catalog explicitly identifies this as a landed configuration. Official preview PNG visually inspected. Download bytes unchanged; GLB header/length/chunks, all bufferView bounds and all 22 embedded texture image decodes pass. Draco geometry decode and browser rendering require separate application tests.
models.limitations: 100 meshes with named SEIS, HP3_v3d_baked, WTS, RISE_antennas, TWINS, IDC, ICC, arm and panel nodes. Instruments are in pre-deployment lander configuration; this is not a full surface-deployed SEIS/HP3 scene or a certified engineering reconstruction. No source animation clips and no mechanical motion enabled. Required Draco compression is provided by NASA; do not silently load without its decoder.
models.decoder: KHR_draco_mesh_compression requires Three.js DRACOLoader and compatible bundled Draco decoder files.
models.configuration: Landed InSight with solar arrays and robotic arm deployed, before seismometer/heat-probe deployment.
